items.title: CNCF Research Shows Virtual Machines Remain Central as AI Workloads Evolve
items.summary: New research from the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) and Linux Foundation Research finds that VMs host an average of 53% of production applications, while emerging AI and agentic workloads are creating additional demand for virtualisation, particularly where stronger execution isolation is required. By Craig Risi

items.title: JEP 545 Moves ZGC Memory Preparation off the Startup Path in JDK 28
items.summary: JEP 545, Faster Startup and Warmup with ZGC, has been integrated into JDK 28, moving heap memory preparation onto concurrent worker threads. ZGC now pre-touches memory as it expands and upgrades small pages to large ones on Linux 6.1 and later, but the 2 MB initial heap behind the JEP's 38% startup and 90% warmup gains requires the adaptive heap sizing flag from JEP 546, which is off by default. By A N M Bazlur Rahman
